anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.text:
verdict: needs-work
addresses-problem: partial — the spec covers rejecting rows without an id, but the line-number requirement has no acceptance criterion. Its ticket row is filed under `## Integration` as "environment state", so nothing gates the second half of the problem statement.
findings:
- [blocker] gap @ `## Integration` "the status report lists the rejected row's line number / ticket row, not an acceptance criterion: environment state" — This row describes product behavior, not environment state. The problem statement requires it ("identify rejected line numbers"), and the Design commits to it ("Report each rejected input line number"). As placed, the spec can be marked done without the status report ever listing a line number. → Move it verbatim into `## Acceptance criteria` as `- [ ] the status report lists the rejected row's line number` with `in-scope`, and remove it from `## Integration`. — probed: none
- [major] gap @ `## Acceptance criteria` "after deploy to staging, login succeeds against the real identity provider / in-scope" — This row is Post-deployment class: it can only be observed after deploy against a real external system. Per the AC classes it should be relocated to post-deployment housekeeping and never kept as an AC. It is also unrelated to the importer problem. → Remove it from `## Acceptance criteria` and relocate it, verbatim, to a non-blocking Post-deployment housekeeping section. — probed: none
- [major] ambiguity @ `## Acceptance criteria` "on staging, the importer rejects an empty name" vs `## Design` "Test the parser ... against local inputs with ... an empty name" — The AC gates on staging, but the Design proves the behavior only locally. The verification and the criterion do not match, and the staging clause makes the row post-deployment-observable. → Either keep the behavior as an AC proven locally, with the staging clause relocated to Post-deployment housekeeping, or specify how the staging check is run before closure. Do not leave both readings. — probed: none
- [minor] ambiguity @ `## Integration` "- on staging" — This bullet is an orphaned qualifier with no disposition and no row it attaches to. It appears to be a split-off fragment of the empty-name row. → Remove it, or reattach it to the row it qualifies with an explicit disposition. — probed: none
- [minor] ambiguity @ `## Design` "Report each rejected input line number" — The spec does not define:
  - where the number is reported (the status report is implied, not stated);
  - whether numbering is 1-based;
  - whether a header line counts.
  
  → State the report target, the numbering base, and the header handling, and test one fixture with a header row. — probed: none
- [minor] other @ `## Integration` "the change merges only after the vendor confirms the fix / ... merge or deploy condition" — This row depends on an outside party handing over a confirmation. That makes it an External-input dependency, which should be parked with the blocker named, not filed as a plain merge condition. → Re-label its disposition as an external-input dependency on vendor confirmation. — probed: none
lean: nothing to cut
